$comment: The ISEDRAF FIXED PRIVILEGED OPERATION registry (D-123, docs/architecture/FULL_AUDIT_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md section 4). Consumed by scripts/ci/check_privileged_operations.py. Every privileged acquisition maps to exactly one entry here (AUTH-004); no entry takes a caller input (AUTH-003). Design only: no entry is IMPLEMENTED and no supervisor exists.

operations.purpose: Read one mountinfo table for each distinct mount namespace on the host.
targets: /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt for every pid, deduplicated by namespace
operations.privilege_basis: reading other processes' namespace links and mountinfo needs ptrace read access to them

operations.purpose: Read the authorized_keys files of local accounts.
targets: per-account key files; derivation not yet specified
operations.privilege_basis: other users' home directories are not traversable by the engine identity

operations.purpose: Read the local shadow password database.
operations.privilege_basis: the file is readable by root (and on some distributions group shadow) only

operations.purpose: Read the declared OpenSSH server configuration and its include graph.
targets: files it includes, resolved by the engine's include rules after return
operations.privilege_basis: sshd_config is 0600 and sshd_config.d 0700 on the EL family

operations.purpose: Read the sudoers policy, its include graph and the sudoers.d listing.
Obtain the effective OpenSSH server configuration.
targets: the output of the fixed executable below
operations.privilege_basis: sshd -T loads the host keys, which are readable by root only
